description: This file contains functions for translating MAC layer PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) configurations into FAPI (FAPI Interface) protocol messages, including handling codewords, DMRS, frequency/time allocations, precoding, and CORESET configurations for 5G NR.

methods.name: get_crb_interval
methods.description: Determines the CRB interval based on coreset configuration or bandwidth part configuration.

methods.name: fill_codewords
methods.description: Fills codeword parameters into the FAPI PDU builder, supporting a single transport block.

methods.name: fill_codeword_information
methods.description: Sets codeword information parameters such as NID, reference point, and number of layers.

methods.name: fill_dmrs
methods.description: Sets DMRS (Demodulation Reference Signal) parameters in the PDU.

methods.name: fill_frequency_allocation
methods.description: Configures frequency resource allocation in the PDU based on VRB to PRB mapping.

methods.name: fill_precoding_and_beamforming
methods.description: Configures precoding and beamforming parameters, optionally using MAC-provided info.

methods.name: fill_pdsch_information
methods.description: Fills basic PDSCH parameters including codewords, DMRS, time, and power info.

methods.name: fill_coreset
methods.description: Configures CORESET parameters based on trans_type and configuration.

methods.name: get_pdsch_trans_type
methods.description: Determines the PDSCH transmission type based on CORESET ID, search space, and configuration flags.

methods.name: get_vrb_to_prb_mapping_type
methods.description: Maps VRB to PRB mapping type from internal enum to FAPI enum.

methods.name: convert_pdsch_mac_to_fapi
methods.description: Main function converting various MAC PDSCH configurations into FAPI PDU messages, supporting multiple input types.
